title: Why Hakari's Mother Locked Her Away — Part 7

series.summary: Dragged before Hahari's throne, Rentarou stares her down, and the ice queen's past surfaces: first love, baby Hakari, and a grave at sunset that explains everything.

segments.voiceover_text: Dragged before Hahari's throne, Rentarou does not beg. He stares her down with burning green eyes and demands Hakari's freedom. The queen of this mansion barely blinks. But when she sighs and closes her eyes, something buried flickers across her face.

Years ago, Hahari loved someone too — rose petals, a first dance, a baby girl warm in her arms. Then a grave at sunset, and Hahari standing alone in black. Hakari became her whole world. That is exactly why she locked her away from everyone. So what happens when that frozen heart meets Rentarou's eyes?
